task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use the left arm to grab the fan with grid cover, then align it on the Cyan mat facing the robot.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用左臂抓住带网格盖的风扇，然后将其对准机器人面向的青色垫子上。
